'''Mos Ila''' was a settlement on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was established in the years of the [[Great Galactic War]] by [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] who had [[Mos Ila Spaceport|restored]] a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] in the hopes of encouraging trade in the region. However, the [[Exchange]] took over the settlement and drove the Jawas back into the deserts. Not long after, the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] arrived unannounced and claimed the settlement. In doing so, they deposed the Exchange and flushed out their opposition. This allowed a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] garrison to be stationed in the region in order to explore the region of [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]], a former [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] outpost in order to find Czerka's abandoned Secret Weapons division laboratory.
